<div class="hero-shell"><div class="eyebrow">REPRODUCIBLE BATCH-EFFECT BENCHMARKING</div><h1>Benchmarking methods that learn through batch effects.</h1><p class="hero-copy">A benchmark-first view of batch correction and downstream classification: fixed datasets, transparent protocols, paired validation/test evaluation, and reproducible model runs.</p><div class="hero-actions"><a class="button-primary" href="#leaderboard">Explore leaderboard</a><a class="button-secondary" href="#datasets">Browse datasets</a></div></div>
<div class="stat-grid"><div class="stat-card"><span id="stat-datasets">—</span><small>datasets available</small></div><div class="stat-card"><span id="stat-runs">—</span><small>scored runs</small></div><div class="stat-card"><span id="stat-protocols">—</span><small>evaluation protocols</small></div><div class="stat-card"><span id="stat-contributors">—</span><small>contributors</small></div></div>
## A benchmark should make comparison easier.
<div class="feature-grid"><article class="feature-card"><div class="feature-index">01</div><h3>Cross-batch evaluation</h3><p>Separate validation and test behavior so a method cannot look strong by fitting one convenient split.</p></article><article class="feature-card"><div class="feature-index">02</div><h3>Standardized datasets</h3><p>Use versioned datasets and explicit batch structure so experiments stay comparable as methods evolve.</p></article><article class="feature-card"><div class="feature-index">03</div><h3>Multiple metrics</h3><p>Keep predictive performance and batch-effect diagnostics visible instead of hiding them in one number.</p></article><article class="feature-card"><div class="feature-index">04</div><h3>Reproducible runs</h3><p>Connect results to the exact protocol, dataset source, and run provenance that produced them.</p></article></div>
## Current leaders {#leaderboard}
<p class="section-copy">Read-only preview of the existing local leaderboard. Score = min(validation MCC, test MCC), matching the current implementation.</p>
<div class="leaderboard-controls"><label>Dataset<select id="filter-dataset"></select></label><label>Protocol<select id="filter-protocol"></select></label><label>Search<input id="filter-search" type="search" placeholder="Method or user…"></label></div>
<div class="table-note"><span id="row-count"></span> · click a heading to sort</div>
<div class="leaderboard-table-wrap"><table class="leaderboard-table"><thead><tr><th>#</th><th data-key="submission_name">Method</th><th data-key="dataset">Dataset</th><th data-key="score">Score</th><th data-key="valid_mcc">Valid MCC</th><th data-key="test_mcc">Test MCC</th><th data-key="accuracy">Accuracy</th><th data-key="evaluation_protocol">Protocol</th></tr></thead><tbody id="leaderboard-body"></tbody></table></div>
## Available datasets {#datasets}
<div class="toolbar"><input id="dataset-search" class="search-input" type="search" placeholder="Search datasets…"><span id="dataset-count" class="muted"></span></div>
<div id="dataset-grid" class="benchmark-grid"></div>
<script>
(function(){var d=window.BE_SITE_DATA||{stats:{},leaderboard:[],datasets:[]};["datasets","runs","protocols","contributors"].forEach(function(k){var e=document.getElementById("stat-"+k);if(e)e.textContent=d.stats[k]||0;});var ds=document.getElementById("filter-dataset"),ps=document.getElementById("filter-protocol"),q=document.getElementById("filter-search"),tb=document.getElementById("leaderboard-body"),rc=document.getElementById("row-count");var uniq=function(k){return Array.from(new Set(d.leaderboard.map(function(r){return r[k];}).filter(Boolean))).sort();};var opts=function(label,vals){return '<option value="">All '+label+'</option>'+vals.map(function(v){return '<option value="'+v+'">'+String(v).replaceAll("_"," ")+'</option>';}).join("");};ds.innerHTML=opts("datasets",uniq("dataset"));ps.innerHTML=opts("protocols",uniq("evaluation_protocol"));var sk="score",sd=-1,fmt=function(v){return v===null||v===undefined?"—":Number(v).toFixed(3);};function render(){var rows=d.leaderboard.filter(function(r){return(!ds.value||r.dataset===ds.value)&&(!ps.value||r.evaluation_protocol===ps.value)&&(!q.value||[r.submission_name,r.username,r.dataset].join(" ").toLowerCase().includes(q.value.toLowerCase()));});rows.sort(function(a,b){var av=a[sk],bv=b[sk];if(av==bv)return 0;if(av==null)return 1;if(bv==null)return-1;return typeof av==="number"?sd*(av-bv):sd*String(av).localeCompare(String(bv));});rc.textContent=rows.length+" results";tb.innerHTML=rows.map(function(r,i){return '<tr><td class="rank-cell">'+(i+1)+'</td><td><strong>'+(r.submission_name||"unnamed")+'</strong><small class="cell-sub">'+(r.username||"")+'</small></td><td>'+String(r.dataset||"").replaceAll("_"," ")+'</td><td><strong>'+fmt(r.score)+'</strong></td><td>'+fmt(r.valid_mcc)+'</td><td>'+fmt(r.test_mcc)+'</td><td>'+fmt(r.accuracy)+'</td><td><span class="protocol-pill">'+(r.evaluation_protocol||"—")+(r.cv_folds?" · "+r.cv_folds:"")+'</span></td></tr>';}).join("")||'<tr><td colspan="8" class="empty-state">No results match these filters.</td></tr>';};[ds,ps].forEach(function(e){e.addEventListener("change",render);});q.addEventListener("input",render);document.querySelectorAll("th[data-key]").forEach(function(th){th.addEventListener("click",function(){var k=th.dataset.key;if(sk===k)sd*=-1;else{sk=k;sd=["score","valid_mcc","test_mcc","accuracy"].includes(k)?-1:1;}render();});});render();
var si=document.getElementById("dataset-search"),grid=document.getElementById("dataset-grid"),dc=document.getElementById("dataset-count");function renderDatasets(){var needle=(si.value||"").toLowerCase(),items=d.datasets.filter(function(x){return !needle||[x.key,x.label].join(" ").toLowerCase().includes(needle);});dc.textContent="showing "+items.length+" of "+d.datasets.length;grid.innerHTML=items.map(function(x){return '<article class="benchmark-card"><div class="tag-row"><span class="tag">batch effects</span></div><h3>'+x.label+'</h3><p class="dataset-key">'+x.key+'</p><div class="benchmark-meta"><span><strong>'+x.runs+'</strong> scored runs</span><span><strong>'+x.protocols.length+'</strong> protocols</span></div><button class="dataset-link" data-dataset="'+x.key+'">View results →</button></article>';}).join("")||'<div class="empty-state">No datasets match this search.</div>';grid.querySelectorAll(".dataset-link").forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener("click",function(){ds.value=b.dataset.dataset;render();document.getElementById("leaderboard").scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth"});});});}si.addEventListener("input",renderDatasets);renderDatasets();})();
</script>
